reviews.title: Free of forever chemicals
reviews.review_text: These do not have forever chemicals like most bandaids do. They are expensive but it's why I choose them.

reviews.title: Stays put
reviews.review_text: Cute and they don't fray like other bandaids made from that material.

reviews.title: Allergic to latex?
reviews.review_text: Best alternative found to avoid latex allergy reaction.

reviews.title: Mixed Style and Mixed Results
reviews.review_text: "Keeps wounds dressed. Comes off without distress." That is how these bandages are described. That's not 100% accurate. I have used welly bandages in the past without any problem. Recently, I took one off and while half of it on the end of the pad came off okay, the other half tore off some skin clinging to it. Ouch! I like the patterns and design of the specialty bandages for hard to bandage things like toes, knuckles, etc. I like that they come in a tin. Cardboard boxes are flimsy and don't always survive until the last bandage is used. The tins can be kept in my glove box or center console in my car. I like being able to use the empty tins for small objects.
